review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Use the storage value sent with the request.** If a caller changes a shared `modelOptions.store` while the request is pending, this check can use a different value from the one sent. An unstored response without an ID then throws instead of returning its image. The public activity passes `modelOptions` by reference. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TanStack/ai/d10f1de96676065a181e8a35d3fd26192daa5b56/packages/ai/src/activities/generateImage/index.ts)) Use `request.store !== false` here so the response uses the request’s captured value.
